retention: At durable write boundary mark browser unresolved BEFORE write. Successful reservation returns RESERVED_LOCK_RETAINED; wrapper return/journal explicitly mark UNRESOLVED_LOCK_RETAINED_NO_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE. Write/journal uncertainty fails closed with REGISTERED_BROWSER_RESERVATION_UNCONFIRMED_LOCK_RETAINED. Host normal local Session cleanup still runs, but automatic lock deletion is suppressed after this boundary. No browser finish/unlock port introduced.
